business_problem: Shifeng Culture wanted to turn traditional children's toys into interactive AI products, but needed help with large-model integration, low-latency interaction, security and scalable product delivery.
solution_summary: Shifeng Culture worked with Baidu AI Cloud to convert its toy portfolio from conventional hardware into AI-enhanced interactive products. Baidu provided a one-stop large-model and interaction stack built on Qianfan development platforms, an ultra-low-latency interaction layer and cloud security services so the toy maker did not have to assemble core AI infrastructure from scratch. In the target design, toy conversations and commands route through Baidu's interaction platform, where model services generate responses and moderation systems protect the resulting data flows. The platform is deliberately built as a productized capability rather than a single pilot: it is meant to help Shifeng respond to market demand faster, personalize toy behavior and open new revenue paths such as subscriptions or value-added digital content. By standardizing the AI layer and cloud safety controls, Baidu reduced the integration burden that would otherwise slow product rollout and make privacy governance harder.

solution_components.name: Qianfan AppBuilder
solution_components.role: Packages toy-interaction workflows and product features on top of model services.

solution_components.name: Qianfan ModelBuilder
solution_components.role: Provides the model-development foundation for toy intelligence and customization.

solution_components.name: Intelligent Interaction Platform
solution_components.role: Delivers low-latency interaction services and device-access capabilities for toys.

solution_components.name: Cloud Security Services
solution_components.role: Protects interaction data and enforces safety and privacy controls.

data_flow: Toy interactions are routed through the low-latency interaction platform, where model services generate responses and cloud security controls moderate and protect data before results are sent back to child-facing devices.
business_outcome: Shifeng Culture gained a standardized AI foundation for smarter toys, stronger product differentiation and new service models without taking on the full complexity of model infrastructure and data security alone.
architecture_clues: The platform is designed for one-stop integration across toy product lines
Low-latency interaction is treated as a core product requirement
Cloud moderation and privacy controls are part of the design
evidence_quotes: Shifeng saw huge potential for large models in children's toys and actively explored the fusion of toys and technology (original: 公司敏锐捕捉到人工智能大模型技术在儿童玩具领域的巨大应用潜力，积极探索玩具与科技融合的无限可能).
Baidu AI Cloud provides an ultra-low-latency interaction platform, broad access methods and a one-stop solution (original: 提供超低延时的智能交互平台，提供完备的接入方式，适配产品广，提供一站式解决方案).
Baidu also provides comprehensive cloud security and content-review mechanisms to protect toy interaction data and privacy (original: 百度智能云提供了完善的云端安全服务，包括全面的安全内容审核机制，保障玩具交互数据的安全和隐私).
